description: This file provides support for interacting with OpenRouter's /v1/chat/completions API endpoint, including configuration, request/response transformation, model capability checks, and streaming response handling specific to OpenRouter's implementation and requirements.

classes.name: CacheControlSupportedModels
classes.description: An enumeration of models that support cache control in content blocks, specifically 'claude' and 'gemini'.

classes.name: OpenrouterConfig
classes.description: A configuration class extending OpenAIGPTConfig, adding support for OpenRouter-specific parameters, cache control features, and response transformations.

classes.name: OpenRouterChatCompletionStreamingHandler
classes.description: A class to handle streaming chat completion responses from OpenRouter, parsing chunks, handling errors, and transforming data.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported parameters for a given model, including reasoning parameters if applicable.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps and adds OpenRouter-specific parameters to the request payload.

methods.name: bool _supports_cache_control_in_content(self, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if a model supports cache control within content blocks.

methods.name: Tuple[List[AllMessageValues],Optional[List["ChatCompletionToolParam"]]] remove_cache_control_flag_from_messages_and_tools( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], tools: Optional[List["ChatCompletionToolParam"]] = None, )
methods.description: Removes cache control flags from messages and tools if the model does not support them.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] _move_cache_control_to_content( self, messages: List[AllMessageValues] )
methods.description: Moves cache control information from message level to within content blocks for OpenRouter compliance.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms and prepares the request payload, including cache control handling and adding usage info.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: Any, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Processes the API response, extracting cost data and formatting the ModelResponse object.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns an appropriate exception class based on the error message and response headers.

methods.name: Any get_model_response_iterator( self, streaming_response: Union[Iterator[str], AsyncIterator[str], ModelResponse], sync_stream: bool, json_mode: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Returns a streaming response handler for OpenRouter chat completions.
